description: This file provides a client API wrapper for making HTTP requests to a backend server, including functions for building URLs, handling responses, and specific API calls such as listing users, sessions, deployments, and checking health status.

methods.name: getApiClient
methods.description: Returns an axios-like client with methods for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE using fetch.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Checks backend health status, with fallback to a specific API endpoint.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Fetches a list of users with optional filtering, pagination, and sorting.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Fetches a list of session tracking records.

methods.name: listDeployments
methods.description: Fetches a list of application deployments.

methods.name: listLlmCosts
methods.description: Fetches a list of LLM cost records.
